verdict.rationale: Poke documents its own automation capability. Recipes let users "set up automations and integrations", external services can trigger Poke via its API, and Poke describes itself as a proactive assistant. The depth of background autonomy is thin: the docs do not show recurring schedules, how autonomous runs are configured or monitored, or how background execution behaves. missing for 10: documented recurring/scheduled background runs, details on configuring and monitoring autonomous automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
